thread:
marta: FYI CI linux shard 71 turned red after the toolchain image bump. Failing linker error in //third_party/libxyz:libxyz.so

marta: buildkite: https://ci.company/rd/12345

marta: log snippet:
```
/usr/bin/ld: .objs/libfoo.a(thread_local.o): in function `make_key':
thread_local.c:(.text+0x1a): undefined reference to `pthread_key_create'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

marta: This started right after rolling gcc image from gcc-12 -> gcc-13. Quick triage: can someone kick a rerun and/or bisect? Suspect link flags or gold vs lld change.

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled for shard 71 (buildkite #12346) :gear:

kevin: I can take a look. Two quick guesses: missing -pthread on the link line, or the default linker changed (gold -> lld). Can you paste `bazel build --sandbox_debug //third_party/libxyz:libxyz.so` output or run with `--experimental_action_listener=//tools:link_debug`? 

sam: If it's -pthread, adding `linkopts = ["-pthread"]` to the cc_binary/cc_library might fix, but we should bisect the toolchain change first.

marta: grabbing a reproducer now. docker command I'm using:
```
docker run --rm -v $PWD:/work -w /work gcc:13 bash -c "bazel build //third_party/libxyz:libxyz.so --config=remote"
```

kevin: ok I reproduced locally with gcc:13. Link line indeed missing -pthread. Looks like our toolchain's linkstamp or crosstool default changed.

jen: @kevin can you try a minimal patch adding `linkopts` so CI green for now? Then we can bisect the toolchain image to find root cause.

kevin: created quick PR #7890 with `linkopts = ["-pthread"]` on the library. Running presubmit.

ci-bot: Presubmit passed on linux-shard-71 for PR #7890 :white_check_mark:

marta: thanks. I'm still running a binary bisect across the image roll to confirm where the linker behavior changed. Will update thread with results.

sam: thanks all. If bisect shows linker swap, we should pin linker or adjust toolchain defaults. :+1:

marta: update: bisect points to image build 2026-02-12 where ld was switched to `lld-15` by default. Filing follow-up to eng-runtime to discuss permanent fix.

jen: nice triage — leaving assignment to eng-infra to decide long-term.
